pokedexEntries.go: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.

pokedexEntries.si: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

pokedexEntries.cr: In truth, it is a cowardly POKéMON. It growls eagerly in order to hide its fear from its opponent.

pokedexEntries.rs: By baring its fangs and making a scary face, SNUBBULL sends smaller POKéMON scurrying away in terror. However, this POKéMON seems a little sad at making its foes flee.

pokedexEntries.su: Despite its intimidating face, it’s quite cowardly. Its desperate attempts to appear threatening make it popular with people.

pokedexEntries.mo: Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

pokedexEntries.us: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.

pokedexEntries.um: In contrast to its appearance, it’s quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.
